name: native-unsaved-lifecycle
goal: Native close, reload and quit with unsaved game edits ask Stay or Discard; Stay keeps the document and backend; hosted selection rereads the open local project.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Unsaved native close, reload and quit must offer Stay or Discard. Stay must retain a responsive local backend. Hosted wrappers must reread current local identity while busy.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard startup mock checked only singleton startup; the browser fixture used Chromium dialogs for Electron. Extend startup lifecycle and hosted-wrapper matrices; keep browser unload coverage and verify native UI separately.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 07ef8e0a9 the standardized startup and hosted-wrapper tests fail: no native unload decision, backend stops before a quit can be canceled, current local selection is blocked. Paired recorder preserves actual failures.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Confirm native unload through Electron Stay or Discard, shut down only at will-quit, and allow same-local identity reads through the hosted wrapper. Add native-host acceptance to existing project skill.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
